name: Way of the Sun Soul
description: A legacy monk subclass from Xanathar's Guide to Everything.

grants.name: Radiant Sun Bolt
grants.description: Gain a 30-foot ranged spell attack using Dexterity, Proficiency Bonus, and your Martial Arts die; it deals radiant damage. It can replace attacks in the Attack action. After attacking with it, spend 1 Focus Point to make two more as a Bonus Action.

grants.name: Searing Arc Strike
grants.description: Immediately after the Attack action, spend 2 Focus Points to cast Burning Hands as a Bonus Action. Spend additional points to increase its slot level by one per point, with total points limited to half your Monk level.

grants.name: Searing Sunburst
grants.description: As an action, create a 20-foot-radius burst at a visible point within 150 feet. Creatures in it that are not behind opaque total cover make a Constitution save, taking 2d6 radiant damage on a failure and none on a success. Spend up to 3 Focus Points to add 2d6 damage per point.

grants.name: Sun Shield
grants.description: Emit bright light for 30 feet and dim light for 30 more; extinguish or restore it as a Bonus Action. While shining, when a creature hits you with a melee attack, use a Reaction to deal radiant damage equal to 5 + your Wisdom modifier.
